verdict.why: The right build has a readable saloon-like identity (checkered facade, crenellated parapet, barrels, lanterns, fenced grass plot, dark roof), while the left is a plain red box with timber stripes and a stepped gable that reads more like a barn; the right's crenellations and tower-like roof top are a little odd from the side, but it is still the more finished, street-ready build.
